scope: Eight animation-only FBX sources and their paired geometry/animation sources.
validation: Imported data inspection only. Animator playback, binding to a scene instance, event execution, and visual motion were not tested.

items.note: Source binary inspection found bones and animation curves but no Geometry in the Open/Hide file. Its paired Close/Flip FBX supplies the geometry and avatar used by the existing prefabs. Positive duration and curve bindings confirm imported animation data, not a playback pass.
